name: Marble Paw
tagline: The operating system for the modern pet-care business.
positioning: Marble Paw unifies bookings, client records, vaccination compliance, and payments into one command center built for independent groomers, vets, and boarders.

hero.h1: Run every paw through one platform.
hero.sub: Marble Paw replaces the reception binder, the whiteboard schedule, and the shoebox of vaccination cards with a single system built to run your entire pet-care operation.

features.title: Bookings that never double-stack
features.description: A real-time calendar that knows your groom bays, exam rooms, and boarding runs — so two clients never land in the same slot again.

features.title: One record per pet, forever
features.description: Every visit, weight, allergy, and grooming note lives on a single profile your whole team can pull up before the leash hits the counter.

features.title: Vaccination compliance on autopilot
features.description: Marble Paw flags expired rabies and Bordetella records and auto-reminds owners, so no unvaccinated dog ever walks into your kennel.

features.title: Payments at the counter
features.description: Deposits, tips, and package plans processed in seconds — with automatic invoices sent before the client reaches their car.

features.title: Staff schedules that hold
features.description: Assign groomers and techs to shifts, cap their daily load, and let clients only book the people who are actually working.

features.title: Automated client reminders
features.description: Recurring six-week groom reminders and appointment texts that quietly refill your calendar without a single phone call.

testimonials.quote: We ran three groomers off a paper diary for nine years. Marble Paw cut our no-shows in half in the first month and I finally stopped taking booking calls at dinner.
testimonials.name: Danielle Ortega

testimonials.quote: The vaccination flagging alone justified it. We used to catch expired records at check-in and turn people away. Now the system catches it a week out and emails them.
testimonials.name: Dr. Marcus Feld

testimonials.quote: I onboarded four kennel staff in an afternoon. Everyone sees the same schedule, the same pet notes, the same runs. It runs the building for us now.
testimonials.name: Priya Raman

pricing.blurb: For solo operators and single-location shops finding their footing.
For growing teams that need scheduling, payments, and reporting in one place.
For multi-location groups running a portfolio of pet-care businesses.

homepage.footerBlurb: Marble Paw is the operating system for independent pet-care businesses — one platform for bookings, records, compliance, and payments.
